say.variants.experienced: We're scraping the bottom of the pantry here, {addressee.name}. Gotta stretch every can we've got.
Opened the crates this morning and they're looking mighty thin, {addressee.name}. Food's getting tight.
Every cupboard on this block is picked clean, {addressee.name}. We need a real supply run soon.
say.variants.rumor: Word is food's getting scarce down the road, {addressee.name}. Folks are already fighting over canned goods.
Heard from travelers that the pantries in the next town are bone dry, {addressee.name}.
People along the highway are saying rations are drying up fast, {addressee.name}.
say.variants.uncertain: Can't swear to it, {addressee.name}, but talk is food's getting hard to find out past the creek.
Hard to say how bad it is yet, {addressee.name}, though folks passing through look awful hungry.
Might just be talk, {addressee.name}, but everybody's hoarding soup cans like winter's already here.
say.variants.reply: Yeah, {addressee.name}, I noticed our rations thinning out too. Best we stretch what's left.
Then we keep our traps checked and our eyes open for any canned goods, {addressee.name}.
Makes sense, {addressee.name}. Let's ration the dry goods and check the back kitchens.
